in_urdu.name: بطول

It was also the name of some of the most revered and respected women in early Islamic history, such as Umm Salama (ra) and Umm Amma Al-Ansariya (ra), who were known for their exemplary character and devotion to their faith. As a result, the name has come to symbolize the ideal Islamic woman, who embodies the virtues of modesty, purity, and piety.

The name Batool can be seen as a call to sacrificing worldly desires and focusing on the eternal reward of the hereafter.
